summary_oneline: Compose a FlexDashboard agent (PandasAgent + InfographicAuthoringMixin + skills + kb) over six QuerySource slugs, reusing the existing deterministic A2UI recipe/refresh lane end-to-end — no core changes required.

localization.role: Base class. Already accepts query= (QuerySource slugs), builds an internal DatasetManager, exposes add_query()/refresh_data(), and has output_routing (FEAT-224) for auto STRUCTURED_CHART/TABLE/MAP selection.
The 'DatasSourceManager' of the ticket. add_dataset(query_slug=...) registers each of the six slugs as a lazy QuerySlugSource with description + usage_guidance + permanent_filter.
LLM-facing ad-hoc QuerySource executor (slug or raw SQL). Optional here — fixed slugs are better served by DatasetManager registration.

Direct architectural precedent (FEAT-420): NarrativeMixin + InfographicAuthoringMixin + PandasAgent, dataset registration in configure(), tier-2 publish_recipe with LayoutSpec v2 (KPICard/DataTable), skill_paths opt-in.

End-to-end demonstration of the requested refresh lane: @infographic_transformer with filter params, publish_recipe, RecipeRunner deterministic replay, A2UIRuntime callAgentFunction→refresh_dashboard, surface filter state per surfaceId. Docstring cites the Flex Program report as its lineage.
Requested toolkit: render/render_template/render_data_template + A2UI envelope builders; template_dirs validated eagerly at construction.
Requested toolkit: store/get/search/compute_and_store/merge/import_from_tool for intermediate data operations.
Deterministic /trigger activation for the requested /widget and /infographic skills; SkillDefinition.triggers in skills/models.py.
kb attachment plane for the KPI-definition documents; Porygon (agents/porygon.py) shows local_kb=True usage with embedding model config.

The concrete visual target: KPI hero row, Chart.js month charts, pay-code pie, data tables, map, multi-select filter bar with embedded data. NOTE: ticket's artifacts/a2ui_live/ paths do not exist; this file and documents/flex_program_report.html are the real references.

constraints.statement: Recipe numbers must come from registered @infographic_transformer functions over declared datasets, never from replaying LLM-generated code (FEAT-324 G1).
constraints.implication: Each Flex KPI (worked hours by month, payroll by month, payroll %, pay-code allocation, utilization, proximity) needs a named, registered transformer; the dashboard recipe references them by section name.

constraints.statement: publish_recipe forces TransformStep.inputs to equal the SectionDescriptor's dataset alias 1:1, and transformers hard-code their input frame keys.
constraints.implication: DatasetManager aliases for the six slugs must exactly match the keys the new flex transformers read (e.g. inputs['hours'], inputs['finance']).

constraints.statement: Finance_results_bi returns currency columns as formatted strings ('$137,456.85') and mixed grain (month-end dates); flex_hours uses month_start/month_end; fm_* use BOP/EOP dates with inconsistent casing and a 'catagory' typo column.
constraints.implication: Transformers need a deterministic normalization layer (currency parsing, month alignment, column canonicalization) — this is where KPI ambiguity actually lives, and what the kb docs must pin down.

constraints.statement: The interactive-html renderer ships from ai-parrot-visualizations, registers on import, and requires an HTTP origin (file:// breaks Chart.js canvases).
constraints.implication: The agent's rendered dashboards must be served (parrot server static/handlers or --serve harness), not just written to disk.

constraints.statement: InfographicToolkit validates every template_dirs entry eagerly at construction.
constraints.implication: If a Flex HTML template ships with the agent, its directory must exist on every checkout (package data or repo-tracked dir), not a gitignored artifacts path.

constraints.statement: The A2UI v1 dialect surface (renderers, envelope routing, structured outputs) is under very active development, and bots/data.py carries a fresh 'wip: info agent' commit (69422348d).
constraints.implication: Coordinate before building: pin to the current v1 LayoutSpec conventions (path bindings, parrot_optional extensions) and check whether the info-agent WIP overlaps this feature.

new: agents/flex_dashboard.py — FlexDashboard(NarrativeMixin?, InfographicAuthoringMixin, PandasAgent) with the six QuerySource slug datasets registered on its DatasetManager, WorkingMemoryToolkit + InfographicToolkit attached, output_routing enabled.

A registered flex transformer module (payroll contribution, pay-code allocation, rep utilization, proximity staffing) following @infographic_transformer with declared filter params (month, flex_type, pay_code, cost_center).

Dashboard recipe descriptor(s): hero-card KPI row (Worked Hours, Payroll, P&L Revenue, Payroll % to Revenue) + monthly chart sections + pay-code sections, published via publish_recipe and refreshable via the A2UIRuntime refresh_dashboard lane.
Skills: /widget (export any KPI as an A2UI structured chart / map / hero card envelope) and /infographic (InfographicToolkit descriptive infographic), declared as file-based skills with triggers.
kb documents defining each KPI's exact computation (currency parsing, month grain, utilization formula, proximity method) attached via the bot kb plane.
An example/runner (and possibly seed) mirroring examples/agents/a2ui/deterministic_refresh_dashboard.py for the Flex agent.

patterns.statement: FinanceReporter (FEAT-420) — mixin composition, configure()-time dataset registration, section names = transformer names, LayoutSpec v2 KPICard/DataTable, explicit dataset_sql for replay.

deterministic_refresh_dashboard example (FEAT-324/326×469) — transformers with filter placeholders, FileRecipeStore, RecipeRunner byte-identical replay, A2UIRuntime refresh RPC + per-surface filter state.
Porygon — enable_skill_registry + per-agent skills directory (agents/porygon/skills/*.md) and local_kb=True with kb embedding config.

integration_risks.risk: Filter semantics: the requested dashboard filters (Month, Flex Type, Pay Code, Cost Center) do not all exist in all datasets (finance has only project+month; employees have Flex Type but no pay_code).
integration_risks.mitigation: Define per-section filter applicability in the spec; treat filters as per-dataset params on each transformer, not a global cross-filter.

integration_risks.risk: Concurrent WIP: 'wip: info agent' commit on bots/data.py suggests overlapping in-flight work on an infographic agent.
integration_risks.mitigation: Confirm with the author before /sdd-task; rebase the spec on whatever that WIP lands.

integration_risks.risk: Slug data only exists in prod QuerySource (per project convention ENV=prod for data access); deterministic tests can't hit it.
integration_risks.mitigation: Seed synthetic frames for tests like the deterministic-refresh example does (no DB, no network); keep slugs behind DatasetManager lazy fetch.

confidence_map.statement: Every named building block (PandasAgent, DatasetManager slug sources, InfographicToolkit, WorkingMemoryToolkit, skill /triggers, kb, deterministic refresh runtime) already exists; the feature is pure composition with no core-package changes.
confidence_map.reasoning: Each class/API was located and its contract read directly.

confidence_map.statement: FinanceReporter is the correct template for the agent's structure, including its documented pitfalls (alias↔transformer key 1:1, eager template_dirs, explicit dataset_sql).
confidence_map.reasoning: Same base class, same mixins, same recipe machinery, in-file rationale from FEAT-420 review.

confidence_map.statement: The refresh button + in-dashboard filters requirement maps exactly onto the FEAT-469 A2UIRuntime lane (callAgentFunction→refresh_dashboard, per-surface dataModel state), already demonstrated end-to-end.
confidence_map.reasoning: The worked example implements precisely this, and cites the Flex Program report as its origin.

confidence_map.statement: The six slugs are consumed via DatasetManager.add_dataset(query_slug=...) (lazy QuerySlugSource), not via ad-hoc QSourceTool calls.
confidence_map.reasoning: add_dataset explicitly supports query_slug with permanent_filter and usage_guidance; PandasAgent syncs the catalog into the REPL automatically.

confidence_map.statement: /widget and /infographic are implementable as file-based skills with deterministic triggers; /widget additionally needs a small per-KPI export path (agent function or tool) that emits the A2UI structured envelope.
confidence_map.reasoning: Trigger middleware and skill discovery are verified; the exact KPI→envelope export tool is new glue whose shape (agent function vs skill-guided tool call) is a design choice.

confidence_map.statement: The ticket's example paths artifacts/a2ui_live/*.html do not exist; the real references are docs/flex_program_report (39).html and documents/flex_program_report.html.
confidence_map.reasoning: Filesystem checked; the shipped report's ids match the ticket's KPI/filter vocabulary.

confidence_map.statement: KPI computation is the ambiguous core: currency-string parsing, month-grain alignment across three date conventions, and utilization/proximity formulas are not fully derivable from the sample rows.
confidence_map.reasoning: Sample rows show the shape but not the business rules; this is exactly why the ticket asks for kb docs.

confidence_map.statement: An in-flight 'info agent' WIP on bots/data.py may overlap this feature.
confidence_map.reasoning: Single WIP commit message; content not inspected.

unknowns.question: Filter scope: should Month / Flex Type / Pay Code / Cost Center filters apply per-section (only to datasets that carry the column) or act as a global cross-filter (requiring a defined join/mapping between datasets)?
plausible_answers: Per-section: each filter only affects sections whose dataset has the column (simplest, matches the shipped report)
Global cross-filter with a documented dataset→column mapping
Only the Payroll Contribution sections are filterable; the rest are static
unknowns.user_answer: Per-section: each filter only affects sections whose dataset carries that column (matches shipped flex_program_report behavior).

plausible_answers: Markdown docs in the agent's directory attached via kb= / file knowledge base
local_kb=True with a load script into pgvector
Skill assets under the agent's skills directory

unknowns.question: Deployment/persistence target: does this agent run under ai-parrot-server (navigator) with recipes in the server recipe store and dashboards served over HTTP, or standalone with FileRecipeStore + local artifacts like the example?

Both: standalone example + server registration in the same feature

unknowns.question: Proximity Staffing definition: what is the expected computation/output — nearest-employee distance per store (haversine) with a radius threshold (e.g. 25/50 miles), rendered as a map layer, a table, or both?
plausible_answers: Per-store nearest-N employees + distance, map with two layers (stores/employees) and a coverage table
Coverage % of stores with ≥1 employee within a fixed radius, threshold configurable
Just an LLM-answerable computation via the pandas tool, no dedicated dashboard section
unknowns.user_answer: Map + coverage table: per-store nearest-N employees with haversine distance, configurable radius threshold, two map layers plus a coverage table.

No alternative architectures worth a brainstorm.
